Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Operations Specialist, AI Enablement to join our CX & Trust team. Trust, care, and high-quality experiences are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by improving how our AI-powered customer experience and moderation systems support our community.

You’ll evaluate AI-powered customer interactions and automated moderation decisions against Bumble’s policies, processes, and quality standards, helping us understand where our systems are performing well and where they can improve. Through quality reviews, accurate case labelling, golden-set maintenance, and thoughtful analysis, you’ll help ensure AI-supported decisions are consistent, precise, and grounded in the nuance required to serve our members responsibly. You’ll work closely with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager and colleagues across CX & Trust, taking ownership of high-quality work and demonstrating our Bumble values of Courage, Curiosity, Respect, and Excellence as we reimagine how AI can strengthen trust and care across the member experience.

This role will be based in London and will work in a hybrid model.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct quality reviews of AI-powered customer conversations and automated moderation decisions, assessing their alignment with Bumble’s community policies, operational processes, and quality standards.

  • Analyse policy enforcement gaps and nuanced cases, identifying where automated decisions may be inconsistent, unclear, or misaligned with policy intent and surfacing actionable insights for improvement.

  • Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance.

  • Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision.

  • Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact.

  • Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience.

  • Identify patterns and share learnings that can improve AI accuracy and precision, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency, approaching emerging challenges with Curiosity and an agile mindset.

  • Use QA platforms and AI-supported tools, including systems such as Cinder, Zendesk QA, and Bumble’s internal assessment tooling, to monitor quality and understand AI behaviour, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before acting on results.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience or transferable skills from Trust & Safety, content moderation, Customer Experience, quality assurance, or another fast-paced, policy-driven environment.

  • Have a sharp eye for detail and can objectively evaluate conversations, moderation decisions, and other interactions against established policies, processes, and quality standards.

  • Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness.

  • Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings.

  • Are comfortable learning digital tools and platforms and can use data and quality insights to identify meaningful patterns while adapting your approach as systems, policies, and priorities evolve.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your deliverables, and see work through from insight to impact while welcoming feedback as an opportunity to learn and improve.

  • Apply AI thoughtfully and responsibly, assessing outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness rather than relying on them without review, and demonstrate Bumble’s values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and colleagues.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!

About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll own our People operations, systems and data across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle - from onboarding, offboarding and Right to Work through to colleague requests, payroll processes, benefits and compliance. You'll make sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for ways to simplify, automate and improve them.

Data is a big part of this role. We need someone who's genuinely at home in the numbers - happy getting into a complex spreadsheet, reconciling different data sources, spotting inconsistencies and using data to understand what's happening rather than simply reporting what it says.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and automation can remove repetitive work across People Operations. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be curious, willing to experiment and excited about what technology could make better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it. Numbers don't scare you - quite the opposite.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

In practice:

  • You're naturally curious, analytical and highly numerate, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to work independently with complex data.

  • You love improving how things work and have redesigned and implemented processes, rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and good at bringing people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Significant People Operations experience, with ownership of end-to-end People processes.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems.

  • Strong numerical reasoning and advanced Excel skills - you're comfortable reconciling data, spotting anomalies and turning numbers into useful insight.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement and using systems, data and technology to make People Operations better.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate.

  • Confidence working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech in a fast-moving environment.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

  • A background in accountancy, audit, management consulting or another analytically rigorous environment that has given you strong foundations in numerical reasoning, process, controls or data.

And one thing you won't need?

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To provide them with the best renting experience in the world 🌎

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

LOCATION: London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote) 
CONTRACT: Full-time
SALARY: £36,000-£46,000 
START DATE: As soon as possible

More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. 
 
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. 
 
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. 
 
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign.
 
Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others.
 
More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including: 

  • Understanding the key dynamics of public attitudes to climate change and the energy transition.
  • Exploring public opinion on immigration, integration and multiculturalism.
  • Embedding our new Seven Segments with a wider range of organisations, including developing new products and trainings to help people understand the segments.
  • Helping navigate declining trust in institutions, for example exploring why trust in universities and science appears to be falling.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

More in Common is seeking a Senior Research Associate to deliver high-quality research projects. They will work across our core areas of research for clients, media and communications, political polling and partnerships. More in Common UK is a small team with a start-up culture where everyone is expected to execute a range of responsibilities. The role will be based in our London office Monday-Thursday with Friday at the office or working at home. 
 
Research

  • Deliver public opinion research projects using quantitative and qualitative methods
  • Regularly conduct polling and focus groups for clients
  • Provide excellent client management and ensure all outputs for clients are high-quality  
  • Craft research findings into clear, compelling reports and decks that provide actionable insights for clients
  • Contribute to the development of More in Common's research agenda, identifying gaps and opportunities for new projects
  • Cultivate and secure exciting new research projects for More in Common by building relationships with and reaching out proactively to potential partners
Comms and External Engagement
  • Represent More in Common in external settings including media appearances, roundtables, events and conferences
  • Communicate research findings to diverse audiences including policymakers, civil society, and the media
  • Build and maintain relationships with research partners, academic institutions, and partner organisations 
Supervision
  • Support the development of research associates and assistants, providing day-to-day guidance, feedback, and structured professional development
  • Support a hard-working, intellectually-curious and fun team culture, modelling More in Common's values internally and externally


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We look for great people before we look for specific qualifications and experience - so we are open to applications from candidates with great potential but limited experience. 
 
For this role, some experience in professional research or political setting is a plus. This might be in a research agency, think tank, comms or PR firm or other policy, public opinion or political organisation. The role is less suitable for someone whose primary experience is academia.
 
The key elements we’re looking for are:

  • Some professional experience in a research, polling, policy or political context
  • Excellent writing skills and some experience in producing a range of high-quality written outputs (such as reports, op-eds or briefings) for a variety of audiences
  • Some experience interpreting quantitative and qualitative data and producing outputs that tell a compelling story from this data.
  • A strong understanding of the UK political system and a keen interest in current affairs and public policy
  • The aptitude and desire to work in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-quality outputs for clients
  • Curiosity for understanding and engaging people, and a desire to use data to tell insightful stories about Britain today  
We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. We particularly encourage applications from underrepresented and minority communities
 
More in Common wants to meet the aims and commitments set out in our equality policy. This includes not discriminating under the Equality Act 2010. We will include a set of questions related to this in our email acknowledging your application for this role - this will help us understand the diversity of our job applicants.  Answering these questions are completely voluntary and anonymous. The information provided will be kept confidential and will not be linked to your application. The information is going to be used to help us understand the diversity of our organisation.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The application deadline is Sunday 20 September 23:59.
 
Applications should include a CV and a short cover letter (max. two pages). In the covering letter, please write up to 300 words on something that surprises you about public opinion in the UK today, why it surprises, and how you’d like to investigate it further. You must include this in your application for it to be considered.
 
Please apply following the link below.
 
Indicative Timeline (please note these dates remain subject to change) 

  • Initial conversation with a hiring manager: w/c 21 September 
  • Interviews: late September – early October 
  • We expect to make an offer to the successful candidate by mid October if not before.

We want DevOps to be an enabler rather than a gatekeeper. That means building the tooling, automation and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to move quickly and safely without creating unnecessary dependencies on DevOps.

About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers, owning the relationship and making sure they get the very best from us.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.

You’ll have the opportunity to build our corporate client management approach from the ground up: shaping account reviews and performance reporting, bringing together claims, safety, underwriting and finance for our biggest clients, and taking real ownership when something needs to get done. Success is simple: our clients stay with us, get more value from Flock and recommend us to others.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

  • Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

  • Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every client.

  • Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

  • Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

  • Support the commercial management of the smaller number of corporate clients that work with Flock directly.

  • Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

  • A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

  • The ability to work effectively within a broker-led relationship, knowing when to lead, when to support the broker and when to bring in specialist colleagues.

  • Energy and ownership: comfortable picking up a problem and driving it through to a solution, and confident using AI in your daily work to work faster and deliver a better client experience.

  • Preferable: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to the claims process or to building an account management or client service proposition.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

data.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? This role

will focus on developing new business relationships and act as a strategic customer partner within the AI Solutions group (DataForce). DataForce is a rapidly growing service offering high quality data for Human Machine Interaction to some of the most prestigious technology companies in the world. Our department focuses on gathering, enriching and processing training data for Machine Learning in different AI domains.

DataForce is part of the TransPerfect family of companies, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business with offices in more than 100 cities worldwide and we are recruiting globally.

Key position responsibilities:

• Identify potential clients in the target market and complete appropriate research on the prospective client’s business and technical needs

• Identify, qualify and quantify opportunities

• Drive opportunities from lead generation all the way to closure

• Ensure customer success and satisfaction

• Draft and implement business plans

• Understand client’s business and technical requirements

• Become a subject matter expert on our business products, processes and operations, and remain up-to-date on industry news

• Keep track of business opportunities on TransPerfect’s CRM system

• Coordinate production and technology teams across different time zones and cultures

• Generate and manage high-value profitable business deals

• Identify, track and manage KPIs and provide internal and client facing status reports; providing of executive updates including account progress, health, risk and opportunities

• Attend tradeshows and support marketing efforts by contributing to case studies and social media

• Provide accurate weekly forecasts and daily update reports

• Assist in building overall plans/budgets and subsequent adherence; own the overall financial health of assigned client engagements; drive efficiencies across process, people and technology

• Manage stakeholder communication around owned business and accounts

• Assist in training and adoption of technologies and services for internal and client teams

• Propose and implement new innovative offerings


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior communication skills

  • Proven track record in achieving sales target within the AI industry

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. data.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers.

We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems.

Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.

The role:

We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris)

You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both:

  • AI for quantum systems, including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction;
  • quantum and hybrid machine learning, including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning.

You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware.

The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models.
  • Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems.
  • Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics.
  • Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework.
  • Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem.
  • Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events.
  • Help define Quandela’s future AI research directions and mentor junior researchers as the team grows.

Requirements

What we are looking for:

We are looking for an AI scientist, or an experienced industry practitioner with an equivalent background, who is eager to apply state-of-the-art classical machine-learning methods to scientific and engineering challenges in quantum computing. The role is primarily focused on using AI to improve quantum technologies, while also providing opportunities to develop and investigate quantum and hybrid machine-learning models.

  • PhD + 3 years of experience or equivalent industrial R&D experience in machine learning.
  • Strong foundations in modern machine learning, experimental methodology and model evaluation.
  • Excellent scientific programming skills, particularly in Python and common machine-learning frameworks.
  • Experience taking research ideas from initial exploration to robust implementation.
  • Interest in working on both longer term research and concrete product problems.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a focused, multidisciplinary team.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Previous experience applying AI to physical systems, scientific computing, hardware control or experimental data.
  • Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum machine learning or photonic quantum technologies.
  • Experience mentoring junior researchers or helping define technical research directions.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience and expectations
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan

About Charlotte Tilbury Beauty

Founded by British makeup artist and beauty entrepreneur Charlotte Tilbury CBE in 2013, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has revolutionised the face of the global beauty industry by de-coding makeup applications for everyone, everywhere, with an easy-to-use, easy-to-choose, easy-to-gift range. Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty continues to break records across countries, channels, and categories and to scale at pace.

Over the last 10 years, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has experienced exceptional growth and is one of the most talked about brands in the beauty industry and beyond. It has become a global sensation across 50 markets (and growing), with over 2,300 employees globally who are part of the Dream Team making the magic happen.

Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty is a truly global business, delivering market-leading growth, innovative retail and product launches fuelled by industry-leading tech — all with an internal culture of embracing challenges, disruptive thinking, winning together, and sharing the magic. The energy behind the bran­d is infectious, and as we grow, we are always looking for extraordinary talent who want to be part of this our success and help drive our limitless ambitions.

About the role

We’re looking for an ambitious and experienced Retail Manager to join our fabulous, newly appointed Travel Retail team, focusing on the Northern Europe region.  

Responsibilities include building retailer relationships, identifying commercial opportunities, leading a field team comprising of store-based business managers and retail artists and managing corresponding budgets, showcasing strong budget management capability and being confident in retail sales forecasting, reporting and data analysis. 

KPIs are retail sales achievement, market share gains, mystery shopping score and team turnover. 

As a Retail Manager you will

Sales Objectives and Market Share Gains

  • Define development and growth strategies with the Head of Travel Retail, Europe for the designated accounts and implement them successfully in stores. 
  • Deliver sell-out in line with forecast commitments. 
  • Identify and capitalise on opportunities to drive brand awareness, performance, and market share across the region. 

Account Management

  • Build strong relationships with retailer contacts to optimise brand presence, maximize share of voice, and negotiate industry-leading joint trading plans. 
  • Deliver regular business/sales updates and critical market insights, acting as the connection between our stores and the Magic Office. 
  • Lead quarterly business reviews and half-year external strategy meetings, producing strong insights and action-driven 360 plans. 

High Performance Teams

  • With the people partner, recruit high performing Retail teams for each store launch. 
  • Set ambitious and achievable sales targets to the field teams. 
  • Lead and inspire your team of business managers and retail artists. 
  • When needed, address performance and engagement needs identified, building an environment of inclusion and motivation within your defined area.  
  • Work alongside the field training manager to ensure commercial and development training needs are met within the region. 

Brand Image Building and Launch of New Campaigns

  • Work in close collaboration with Travel Retail Marketing & VM teams to develop trade plans and on-counter activities. 
  • Successfully launch and sustain new products and campaigns as per the global Travel Retail Marketing strategy.  

 Effective Commercial & Budget Management

  • With the Head of Travel Retail, Europe, monthly retail forecasting by store.  
  • In alignment with finance and retailer partners, forecast and manage all retail staffing costs, including recommended FTEs, commissions and incentives management.  
  • Manage T&E budget, staying within approved monthly expenditure.  

Operational Excellence

  • Set standards for executional excellence, support new processes, and work cross-functionally to enhance brand presentation and in-store execution, including but not limited to assortment, stock availability on counter, price updates. 

Requirements

  • Must be able to travel within region and to Magic Office regularly. Roughly a 40/60 split
  • Wide experience in Retail or Sales Management, with direct experience in Travel Retail desirable but not mandatory
  • Strong people focus, team spirited and passionate about developing teams. 
  • Proven track record of successful negotiations & ability to influence others. 
  • Target-focused and results-driven. 
  • Excellent numerical and analytical skills. 
  • Effective communicator, both written and verbal with a structured and organised approach 
  • Excellent presentation skills and classroom delivery 
  • Personable and approachable; able to build rapport quickly & effectively 
  • Self-starter; able to motivate oneself and others 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing priorities. Agility is key!  
  • Solution-oriented with ability to problem solve in a timely manner 
  • French language is mandatory 

Charlotte Tilbury is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where nimble mindsets, striving to deliver the best and wanting to be part of a global #dreaamteam are key. Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Nous recherchons un.e Wireless Networking Engineer pour rejoindre notre équipe R&D et prendre la responsabilité de la couche de connectivité qui alimente notre flotte de robots. Vous travaillerez à l'intersection de la robotique, du WiFi, des réseaux, du logiciel et de la performance des systèmes afin de garantir des communications robustes dans des environnements complexes, à forte densité et comportant de multiples clients connectés.

En tant qu'Ingénieur.e Réseaux Sans Fil, vous serez chargé.e de concevoir, surveiller, analyser et améliorer la solution de connectivité sans fil utilisée par les robots Exotec.

Vous enquêterez, diagnostiquerez et optimiserez les infrastructures WiFi et les ressources réseau TCP/IP dans des déploiements à grande échelle, où des centaines de robots mobiles évoluent en permanence au sein d'une infrastructure sans fil tout en maintenant une communication fiable et à faible latence avec les services backend.

Votre travail aura un impact direct sur la performance de la flotte, la disponibilité du système et l'expérience client.

Missions :

  • Concevoir, superviser et optimiser la connectivité WiFi des robots Exotec.
  • Analyser et résoudre les problèmes de performance réseau (WiFi, TCP/IP, roaming, latence, pertes de paquets, interférences RF)
  • Développer des outils et méthodologies de diagnostic, de monitoring et d'analyse des performances.
  • Améliorer la fiabilité des communications des robots autonomes en collaboration avec les équipes Software et Systèmes.
  • Définir les KPI et les stratégies de supervision de la connectivité de la flotte.
  • Participer au développement des couches logicielles de connectivité embarquée (C/C++).
  • Concevoir et réaliser des campagnes de tests et de validation en laboratoire et sur le terrain.
  • Apporter une expertise réseau avancée lors des investigations clients et des déploiements.

Profil :

  • Diplôme de niveau Master (Bac+5) ou équivalent en informatique, télécommunications, réseaux, systèmes embarqués ou domaine connexe.
  • Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en réseaux, communications sans fil, systèmes embarqués ou domaines similaires.
  • Excellente maîtrise des fondamentaux des réseaux TCP/IP.
  • Bonne connaissance des normes IEEE 802.11, notamment : 802.11ac (WiFi 5) ; 802.11ax (WiFi 6) ; WPA2 / WPA3
  • Expérience dans le diagnostic de problèmes réseau complexes à l'aide d'outils de capture de paquets et d'analyse de protocoles.
  • Aisance dans les environnements Linux.
  • Expérience des tests de performance réseau, de l'observabilité et des systèmes de supervision.
  • Goût prononcé pour la compréhension du comportement des systèmes dans des environnements réels.
  • Capacité à intervenir aussi bien sur les aspects logiciels, réseaux que matériels.
  • Approche de résolution de problèmes basée sur les données.
  • Capacité à évoluer dans une organisation d'ingénierie en forte croissance et très collaborative.

Rattaché(e) au Digital Workplace Manager, vous rejoignez une équipe IT de 7 personnes.
Votre périmètre couvre deux dimensions complémentaires : l'administration des environnements cloud et la gestion de l'infrastructure réseau interne. Ce rôle s'inscrit dans une organisation IT structurée, avec de vraies responsabilités techniques dès votre prise de poste.

Le Challenge
Exotec opère dans un environnement multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) en constante évolution, au service de plus de 1 300 collaborateurs répartis dans le monde. La maîtrise de cette infrastructure est un enjeu de continuité et de performance pour l'ensemble de l'entreprise.
Votre défi :

  • Prise en main de l'infrastructure: Acquérir une compréhension complète et approfondie de nos environnements cloud et réseau pour gagner rapidement en autonomie
  • Optimisation des environnements: Identifier les axes d'amélioration et contribuer activement à la rationalisation et la performance de l'infra existante
  • Être force de proposition pour faire évoluer l'infrastructure dans le bon sens, en anticipant les besoins plutôt qu'en subissant les contraintes
  • Collaboration transverse : Tisser des relations de confiance avec les équipes internes pour mieux anticiper et répondre à leurs besoins

Vous analysez les environnements en place, proposez des pistes d'optimisation (coût, performance, résilience) et participez activement à leur mise en œuvre en lien avec l'équipe.

2. Support au déploiement applicatif
Vous accompagnez les équipes de développement dans le déploiement de leurs applications sur Kubernetes, en assurant le lien entre les besoins applicatifs et les contraintes d'infrastructure.

3. Administration et fiabilité des environnements cloud
Vous assurez l'exploitation, la supervision et la maintenance des infrastructures Azure et AWS. Vous êtes garant(e) de leur disponibilité et de leur performance au quotidien.
4. Infrastructure réseau
Vous pilotez l'installation et le maintien en condition opérationnelle de l'infrastructure réseau sur l'ensemble des sites Exotec. 5. Sécurité de l'infrastructure
Vous appliquez et faites évoluer les bonnes pratiques de sécurité sur l'ensemble du périmètre : durcissement des configurations, gestion des accès privilégiés, et vigilance sur les vecteurs de risque courants.

Vous assurez la prise en charge et l'escalade des incidents d'infrastructure, en veillant à la rapidité et à la qualité de résolution. Vous contribuez à la définition et au maintien des dispositifs de continuité (PRA/PCA) pour garantir la résilience des services IT.
7. Documentation et capitalisation
Vous maintenez une documentation technique à jour et de qualité, afin de garantir la lisibilité de l'infrastructure et faciliter la collaboration au sein de l'équipe IT.

MotorK. Driving the AI revolution in automotive.

MotorK is Europe's leading sales and marketing technology company for the automotive sector. We build AI-powered tools: from CRM and inventory management to predictive analytics and digital advertising, that help manufacturers and dealerships sell smarter and deliver better customer experiences. 90% of European automotive manufacturers run on our SparK Platform, alongside 6,000+ dealerships across the continent.

We move fast, we think big, and AI is at the core of everything we do, not as a buzzword, but as the engine behind every product decision we make. We're building a team of people who are genuinely curious about AI, who experiment with it, push it, and find new ways to use it to solve real problems.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team to be based in our Antwerp office. This role would require a relocation to Belgium. 

The Role

The Customer Success Manager role will cover a wide range of account management, onboarding, and client growth tasks, as it liaises with the Delivery, Sales, and Product teams. The Customer Success Manager will:

  • Serve as the primary reference point for clients throughout their entire lifecycle with MotorK, taking full account management ownership.
  • Own the customer onboarding journey from contract signature to successful product go-live, ensuring product activation aligns with the dealer’s digital strategy and signed SLA.
  • Conduct structured onboarding sessions, translate client requirements into clear delivery briefs, and manage cross-functional execution.
  • Drive adoption, prevent churn, and execute upselling/cross-selling activities to meet individual and team revenue goals.
  • Provide ongoing digital marketing, lead generation, and lead management expertise using the DealerK Method.
  • Track and report on key account metrics, including NPS, retention, time-to-go-live, and product adoption rates.

Requirements

Our ideal Customer Success Manager will have previous experience in Sales, Account Management, or Customer Success (ideally within a SaaS or digital product environment) and digital marketing strategy knowledge.

As well as:

  • Previous experience in account management or customer success, with a strong plus for end-to-end customer onboarding ownership.
  • Deep understanding of the B2B automotive dealer sector and web technologies (CMS, SEO concepts) or SaaS industry.
  • Project management mindset with proven ability to bridge business requirements and technical delivery teams.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Native Flemish speaker, fluency in French and English.

Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.

  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus.

  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.

  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.

At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

What we do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

About the Sales Manager role...

Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Barcelona!

 

You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.

 

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

 

We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart, we want to hear from you!

 

What you'll do...

  • Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.

  • Achieving sales KPIs and targets - Working towards daily, weekly and monthly targets and finalize all sales in a timely manner.

  • Presentation and negotiation – Prepare accurate quotes and develop and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins.

  • CRM maintenance – Maintain accurate records of your business development activities on SiteMinder's CRM system.

  • Client feedback – Provide client feedback on products to the Product Team so that products can be reviewed in line with the feedback.

  • Partner management – Work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.

 

What you have...

  • Experience in Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) sales

  • Fluent in German (min. C2)

  • Professional proficiency in English

  • A confident phone presence, fearlessness in leading meetings with prospects, and great listening skills

  • Strong communication skills professionally with customers, in writing and over the phone

  • Self-motivation and resilience to show up each day and give your best

  • Growth mindset - openness to feedback and coaching

  • Please send us your CV in English!

 

Our Perks & Benefits…

  • Remote setup

  • Equity packages for you to share in SiteMinder's growth and successes

  • Investment in your personal growth

  • Uncapped commission that rewards overachievement

  • Excellence-driven, collaborative culture

  • Well-being initiatives

  • Referral bonus for bringing in new talent

  • Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy

  • Paid birthday, study and volunteering days off every year

  • Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved

     

Does this job sound like you? If yes, we'd love for you to be part of our team! Please send a copy of your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

 

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

 

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Please note that this role requires relocation to Dublin, Ireland.

Role Overview

As a Sales Development Representative at Harvey, you will be at the forefront of driving the growth and adoption of our AI solutions across the legal and professional services markets. You will own early-stage pipeline creation across EMEA by engaging law firms, professional services organizations, and in-house legal teams, understanding their unique challenges, and introducing Harvey’s AI platform.

This role combines highly personalized outbound prospecting with thoughtful inbound qualification. Your ability to articulate the value of Harvey's products, paired with curiosity about AI and a rigorous approach to your work, will help us expand our reach and shape the future of knowledge work.

What You’ll Do

  • Build revenue pipeline aligned with Harvey’s strategic customer profile using a variety of outbound tools and highly personalized outreach.

  • Proactively prospect into target accounts across EMEA through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other creative outbound strategies.

  • Source and qualify new sales opportunities through both outbound prospecting and inbound lead follow-up.

  • Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations to understand customer workflows and determine strong opportunities for the sales team.

  • Respond quickly to inbound interest and ensure timely qualification and follow-up.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to develop opportunities and support early-stage deal progression.

  • Provide data-driven insights to inform sales strategies and improve prospecting effectiveness.

  • Contribute to developing Harvey’s sales playbook and document learnings as we scale the team globally.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed qualified pipeline and activity targets.

What You Have

  • 1–2+ years of experience in a fast-growing startup, preferably in sales development or project management.

  • Fluent in written and spoken English and German

  • Strong executive presence and comfort presenting to sophisticated executive buyers.

  • Independent, driven, and approach work with rigor and thoughtfulness.

  • Ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Proficient with Salesforce, Salesloft, and reporting tools.

  • Collaborative team player able to work across internal functions.

  • Passionate about Harvey’s mission with a strong understanding of AI applications in knowledge work.

  • Interest in the legal profession; experience in the legal industry is a plus but not required.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to how Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You’ll Do

  • Engage with English- and German-speaking lawyers at existing and prospective customers to understand their workflow challenges, strategic objectives, and broader firm context — then demonstrate how Harvey’s AI solutions can address them.

  • Establish yourself as a credible expert in solving customers’ specific legal problems (e.g. researching public and private databases for certain types of information, drafting and analyzing contractual provisions and whole documents, analyzing briefs and filings, corporate governance, conducting due diligence).

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Partner with the marketing team to develop content that will resonate with lawyers, tailored to the unique needs of their practice areas and client types.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Tailor the introduction of new solutions to specific customer needs.

  • Further the market perception of Harvey as uniquely credible, substantive, and helpful in applying its AI solutions to make lawyers better at their jobs.

  • Conduct research and analysis on customers and competitors.

What You Have

  • JD or equivalent legal qualification.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • At least 3 years of experience practicing law at a top-tier law firm (Vault 50 or equivalent), preferably with a transactional, in-house or transformation experience.

  • Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both legal and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Strong understanding of legal processes and challenges faced by legal professionals.

  • Curiosity about AI’s potential to transform the legal industry.

  • Sales or customer-facing experience, including law firm business development and/or secondment, is a plus, as is experience directly managing law firm client matters and client relationships.

Additional Information for Postings

  • Location: Germany

  • Work eligibility: Must have valid German work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role

What We Offer

  • Be part of building something special as a founding member of our Germany team

  • Opportunities to work on cross-functional go-to-market initiatives, with a focus on scaling sales strategy and driving revenue growth

This position sits close to the embedded world, but it isn't traditional microcontroller firmware work. You'll own the operating system foundation and platform layer of our IoT devices - building and evolving our next-generation embedded Linux image - and develop the Python application layer that runs on top of it, inside our dockerized main application.

You'll work down at the OS and hardware boundary while shipping features up in the application layer. Typical areas include:

  • Designing and maintaining our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM devices with limited compute

  • Security on device, inter-process communication, networking, scheduling, observation

  • Over-the-air (OTA) updates for both the OS and applications

  • Integrating peripherals - watchdog, modem, AI accelerator - and improving their observability

  • Bridging the system layer and the application layer through Python and Bash

The work spans from driver- and kernel-level integration in C/C++, to adapting our Linux distribution with Yocto to the underlying hardware layer, to debugging system-level failures such as memory leaks, up to writing the Python software that turns hardware capabilities into product features.

You will be expected to pass a live coding interview for this role.

What to expect

  • Embedded Linux Platform: Design, build, and continuously evolve the next generation of our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM-powered IoT devices

  • Application Development: Develop Python-based software that brings hardware capabilities to life and improves the reliability and performance of our products

  • System Integration: Work across the full stack—from kernel and driver integration to application development—connecting hardware, operating system, and product features

  • Device Reliability: Build secure, observable, and resilient systems, including OTA updates, networking, process communication, scheduling, and device monitoring

  • Debugging & Troubleshooting: Analyze and resolve complex issues across the platform, including kernel, drivers, networking, memory management, and application software

  • Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for your solutions, proactively improve our platform, and help shape engineering best practices

Inspire us by

  • Embedded Linux Expertise: Several years of experience developing Embedded Linux systems and confidence working with Linux internals, GNU tools, and Bash

  • Engineering Mindset: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent practical experience

  • Yocto Experience: Proven experience building, customizing, and maintaining Linux images using Yocto

  • Systems Programming: Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as C, C++, Rust, Go, or Java

  • Python Development: Experience developing Python applications or a strong motivation to make Python your primary development language

  • Low-Level Debugging: Hands-on experience with debugging tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind, UART, and JTAG, including troubleshooting memory leaks and system-level issues

  • Operating System Knowledge: Solid understanding of Linux internals, bootloaders, systemd, drivers, kernel concepts, networking, and Docker

Role

You will build a production Android application where AI interactions are core to the product, and performance, reliability, and clarity matter.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain production Android apps using Kotlin.

  • Integrate AI-powered features (chat, vision, voice, recommendations) via backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including streaming responses, retries, and partial results.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and responsiveness for AI-heavy flows.

  • Implement analytics, logging, and feedback capture to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API contracts and system behavior.

  • Ensure app stability, security, and scalability in production environments.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI features (e.g. LLM, vision, speech APIs).

  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming (Coroutines, Flow).

  • Familiarity with REST or gRPC APIs and structured data formats.

  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

  • Comfort building in environments with latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic behavior.

  • Experience with MLKit or light on-device inference.

  • Published production apps on the Google Play Store.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use android applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin / Java

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. data.description:
🎤 Founders Associate - a letter from the person you'd work with

Most job ads are written by no one, for everyone. I want to do this differently.

I'm Marius, Chief of Staff at voize. This role reports to me, and whoever takes it will work more closely with me than anyone else in the company. So instead of a template, here's what this job is, how I work, and how you can decide whether you'd want to work with me.

💡 What this job actually is

voize is growing fast, and fast-growing companies produce a specific kind of work: topics that matter but belong to no one. A new market needs operational groundwork. An org-wide process needs to be built. A decision needs a sharp analysis behind it. We're building a CEO Office to own exactly this work. You'd be its first hire.

I’ll be honest about the range. One week you’re working on a question that I and the rest of the management team will decide the company’s direction on. The next you're doing operational groundwork nobody will ever applaud. Both matter equally, it's the nature of building an early-stage company. If you need every task to feel glamorous, stop reading here. If "done" is your favorite word, keep going.

To make it concrete, your first months could look like this: you own the operational groundwork for one of our new markets end-to-end - research, vendor and partner setup, local operations - until things simply run. And you build one company-wide process from scratch, for example how cross-functional projects get scoped, prioritized, and tracked, and roll it out across the org. Different altitude, same job: you drive it to done.

🚀 How I work

I give trust and autonomy by default. The way I see my job as a manager: set goals you can actually reach, give you the resources to get there, unblock you when you're stuck, teach you what I know - and then get out of the way. I care about outcomes, not hours.

The flip side: you'll get a lot of freedom and little oversight. That's a gift if you work autonomously, and a problem if you don't. Autonomy doesn't mean silence, though. I expect you to ask for help early, not after something has quietly derailed.

I'm very opinionated and direct. You'll always know where you stand with me, and I expect the same back - including telling me when you think I'm wrong.

🎯 What I look for

Your background matters less than your pattern. You might come from consulting, VC, a startup, or something you built yourself. What I care about is this: you take ownership before anyone assigns it. You can be dropped into a topic you know nothing about and produce clarity within days. You hold a high bar for your own work without anyone checking. You ask a sharp question early instead of defending a wrong assumption late. And pace gives you energy instead of draining it.

If you read that and felt recognized rather than impressed - good sign.

🌱 Why voize

The care crisis is one of the most existential problems we face: fewer and fewer people caring for more and more of us. We build something that genuinely helps - over 200,000 caregivers use voize to win back time for people instead of paperwork. Purpose usually comes at the price of ambition. Not here. We combine real impact with high ambition and high speed, and that combination is rare. We raised a $50m Series A from leading investors like Balderton and HV end of last year and there is a lot ahead of us.

🤝 The deal

This job will be intense, and it will be fun. You'll get more exposure in your first year than most roles offer in five - to the CEO, me, the rest of the management team, and every part of the company. I'll invest in your growth personally. And the role isn't fixed: you'll shape it into what you want it to become.

If you read this and think this is for you, please apply no matter who you are or what background you have! I want to meet you 🫶

Marius

This is an execution-focused role offering practical experience within a fast-moving scientific and industrial environment.

Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt.
